Question 5 (continued) 

In part (c) the response did not earn the first point because the improper integral in line 1 has limits of integration 
that are not consistent with region W. The response is eligible to earn the second point because the integrand is of 

the form 1

x _{n} ,  n > 1. The response did not earn the second point because the antiderivative in line 3 is not correct. 

The response did not earn the third point because the boxed answer is not correct.
